section.sectionSummaryBrief: This section provides the date of the maamar: Shabbos and Motzaei Shabbos of Parshas Beshalach, 11 Shevat, 5731.
section.t: B"H.
Shabbos Kodesh and Motzaei Shabbos of Parshas Beshalach,
11 Shevat,

section.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains that the main dwelling of the Shechinah was originally in the lower realms, and through the righteous from Avraham to Moshe, it was brought down again, primarily through the Mishkan.
section.t: "I have come to My garden, My sister, My bride"1,
and the Rebbe, my father-in-law, the Rebbe of the hillula, brings in the maamar of the day of his passing and his hillula2,
that it is stated in Midrash Rabbah
(in its place)
"to My garden, to My bridal chamber,"
to the place which was My primary [dwelling] originally,
for the primary [dwelling] of the Shechinah was in the lower realms,
except that through undesirable matters
(beginning from the sin of the Tree of Knowledge)
the Shechinah departed from below to above, up to the seventh firmament,
and afterwards righteous ones arose
(beginning from Avraham Avinu)
and brought down the Shechinah from above to below,
until Moshe, who is the seventh, came,
and all sevenths are beloved3,
and he brought it down below to earth.
For this matter
(the drawing down and descent of the Shechinah below to earth)
was accomplished primarily4
through the Mishkan that Moshe made, as it is stated5
"And they shall make for Me a Sanctuary, and I will dwell in their midst."
And this is [the meaning of] "The righteous shall inherit the land and dwell forever upon it"6,
that the righteous cause to dwell
(draw down7)
the Shechinah, which is called "Ad" (forever),
"He Who dwells forever, exalted and holy"8,
so that it be revealed below.

section.sectionSummaryBrief: This section clarifies that the maamar reorders the Midrash to teach that after the initial drawing down of the Shechinah through the Mishkan, the righteous continue to draw down an even higher level of divine influence.
section.t: And it is noteworthy,

that in the Midrash there, it first explains the meaning of the verse "The righteous shall inherit the land etc." and afterwards it says that the main dwelling of the Shechinah on earth was on the day the Mishkan was erected,
but in the maamar, it changes the order of the matters,
for the verse "The righteous shall inherit the land etc." is brought in the maamar after it says that the main drawing down was through the making of the Mishkan.
And it can be said,
that by this it hints,
that this [matter] that the righteous draw down the Shechinah below
("and shall dwell forever upon it"),
the intention in this is not only for the drawing down that was through the seven righteous ones from Avraham to Moshe
(through the making of the Mishkan),
but also for the drawing down that comes after the drawing down that was through the making of the Mishkan.
For even after the drawing down that was through the making of the Mishkan,
even though it was a most elevated drawing down,
the righteous draw down,
and "Your people are all righteous"9,
a drawing down that is even more elevated.
For after the drawing down through the seven righteous ones,
and particularly through Moshe, through whom the Shechinah was drawn down below to earth,
through this, the power was given to each and every Jew to draw down even more.
